segments.text: On the last evening of the year, I stopped by a small temple
I had visited it at the same time last year
This is my moment of reflection
Looking back on the year
I think I ought to have been kinder to others
I ought not to have said some of the words I said
The younger me used to be short-tempered
I used to snap at my sister almost every day
Whenever I recall that, I feel ashamed
But my sister would always respond with quiet patience
In the new year, I wanna be more modest
I want to express more gratitude to my family
I want to adopt a small habit
To rise a little earlier and breathe deeply
The temple bell rang
I pressed my hands together
And quietly recalled
My late grandfather
He used to say
A person does not need to speak many words
I wanna inherit that quiet advice now
